basic_info.description: Gorgeous views of the San Francisco Bay and Alcatraz from this light and bright two bedroom, one bathroom condominium in the heart of Russian Hill. A sophisticated design bright with a skylight, soaring ceilings and generous sized windows overlooking the SF Bay and Alcatraz. The open concept living room, dining room and kitchen creates a perfect haven for entertaining while enjoying the spectacular views. The updated kitchen features stainless steel appliances, caesarstone countertops, recessed lighting and custom cabinetry. The property also features a wood burning fireplace in the great room, hardwood floors throughout and generous laundry closet with custom shelving and cabinets. The bathroom features a bathtub with shower above. There is also additional storage for this unit. The condo is located near Fisherman's Wharf, Ghiradelli Square, Aquatic Cove and less than a block from Francisco Park. North Beach and Polk Street Corridor are close for shopping, restaurants and entertainment. Fort Mason is also in close proximity and offers additional dining, Farmer's Market as well as activities for runners and walkers. Neighbors in building open to renting their garage spaces to this unit.
